entity: UK-sanctioned Russia shadow-fleet ships not on the US OFAC list
what_we_add: the UK-only count: 358 of 620 UK-sanctioned ships not on OFAC, and 309 designated in 2024-25; Brookings only gives the combined EU+UK gap (524)
why: Brookings names the UK and states the same finding: hundreds of allied-sanctioned tankers the US hasn't designated, US count frozen since Jan 2025. Nobody states the UK-only 358 or the 309 in 2024-25.
